summary.motive: Manufacture an unblocked free rusher (Nickel DB) while keeping 7 coverage defenders on the field by dropping interior DT into the quick hot-throw window.
summary.whyItWorks: Offensive line protection rules slide to account for defensive linemen, leaving slot DBs unaccounted for; dropping a 300lb DT into the hot slant lane removes the QB’s only escape.
summary.failureMode: Quick wide-receiver tunnel screens to the boundary or RB quick flairs to the vacated edge.

beats.title: Amoeba Front Disguises Creeper Pressure
beats.text: Macdonald aligns in a hybrid 3-3-5 look. Offense checks pass protection to slide toward the heavy interior, assuming standard four-down rush.

beats.title: Nickel Ignites & 3-Tech Drops (Simulated Blitz)
beats.text: The defense rushes exactly 4, but replaces the 3-Tech tackle with Nickel DB coming off the edge. WDE pinches inside, pinning the LT and giving Nickel a free runway.

beats.title: Hot Slant Baited by 300lb Dropper
beats.text: As the QB sees the edge pressure and tries to release his hot slant to X, 3-Tech DT drops directly into the slant window, suffocating the hot throw.

beats.title: Unblocked Blindside Strip Sack
beats.text: With his hot read erased and protection slid the wrong way, the QB is crushed by the unblocked Nickel DB in under 2.5 seconds.

relations.tell: Nickel DB triggers on a blitz trajectory while 3-Tech drops into the shallow throwing lane
